ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels on lateral lobes to low-intensity black pixels in the medial column and perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black central wedge extending from the peduncle to the notch area; symmetrical white lateral lobes; continuous black band along the trailing edges and distal tips; sparse distribution of small black pixel clusters (mottling) across the interior white surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; the apex is occluded by a foreground object, but the visible lobe margins converge at an estimated 35-45 degree angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; right lobe exhibits higher frequency and amplitude of peaks compared to the left lobe; distal tips are highly jagged.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the trailing edge of both lobes, curving from the median notch toward upward-pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized, dark circular pixel clusters scattered on the interior regions of the right white lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged erosion and possible historical tissue loss detected on the right distal fluke tip compared to the left.
other_distinctive_markers: Major occlusion of the median notch and central fluke region by a bird (avian silhouette) in flight.
